title: JB Mono
description: Replaces font with JetBrains Mono | BTA supported
body:
# JetBrains Mono font for Minecraft

Changes the Minecraft font to use the JetBrains Mono font with some special symbols kept vanilla

This resource pack is compatible with Create Mod, the `|` symbol is kept vanilla to make graphs look good (without weird mono-space stuff)

Made it because it takes to effort for me to read other fonts and it's easier to use this one

Better Than Adventure! is supported!
